description: Egress-candidate enumeration for encryption-in-transit. Deliberately broad: matches are candidates, not findings. Precision is the enrichment layer's job, not this file's. False positives are cheap; false negatives are fatal.

network_packages.comment: Manifest layer: any file importing one of these enters the population. Packages not listed here whose names match the network-ish heuristic are flagged for manual review, never dropped.

term_scan.comment: Substring match, case-insensitive, over EVERY file walked — including Dockerfiles, CI configs, shell scripts, .env.example. One candidate per matching line.
